Name: DataKey
Description: The identification of a storage that will receive the guid. When omitted the function returns the guid as its value instead, so it can be used as an expression, for example UpdateItemField({{item.Id}},CreateGuid()). When DataKey is given, DataField is required too

Name: DataField
Description: The data field of DataKey that will receive the guid. Required whenever DataKey is given

Name: Notify
Description: You can choose if you want no notify the change to the observer
